name: AcousticPro Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones
reviews_text: These headphones exceeded my expectations. The active noise cancellation blocks out all office chatter, and the battery easily lasts 30+ hours on a single charge. Super comfortable padding too.

name: AcousticPro Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones
reviews_text: The right ear cup completely died after just 6 days of gentle indoor use. Tried resetting and recharging, but nothing worked. Customer support refused to issue a replacement without me paying return shipping.

name: AcousticPro Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones
reviews_text: Audio clarity and bass response are good for this price tier, but the headband clamp pressure causes headaches after about an hour of listening. Mixed feelings overall.

name: GlowRadiance Hydrating Face Serum
reviews_text: My dermatologist recommended hyaluronic acid, but this formulation caused instant redness, severe stinging, and a burning sensation on my cheeks. Had to wash it off immediately.

name: GlowRadiance Hydrating Face Serum
reviews_title: Holy grail for dry winter skin
reviews_text: My skin has never looked more hydrated and dewy. Lightweight, absorbs in seconds, and doesn't pill under makeup. I have repurchased this bottle three times already!

name: GlowRadiance Hydrating Face Serum
reviews_title: Broken pump dispenser and half leaked
reviews_text: The product inside might be fine, but the bottle arrived with a cracked pump and serum leaked all over the shipping box. Difficult to use without a working dispenser.

name: EcoBlend Stainless Steel Insulated Tumbler
reviews_text: Solid build quality and fits nicely in standard car cup holders. Keeps coffee piping hot for 8 hours. Only minor downside is the lid slider is slightly stiff to open.

name: EcoBlend Stainless Steel Insulated Tumbler
reviews_title: Not as pictured and leaks everywhere
reviews_text: The color received is dull grey, completely different from the vibrant teal in the website photos. Furthermore, the silicone seal is loose, so it spills coffee all over my bag.

name: EcoBlend Stainless Steel Insulated Tumbler
reviews_text: Purchased two of these for our cross-country road trip. Sturdy stainless steel body survived a drop on concrete without denting. Very satisfied with the insulation performance.

name: RapidCharge 65W GaN Wall Charger
reviews_text: Powers my MacBook Pro and iPhone simultaneously at full speed while remaining cool to the touch. Incredibly compact compared to original OEM charging bricks.

name: RapidCharge 65W GaN Wall Charger
reviews_text: Plugged it in to charge my tablet, and within twenty minutes it became scalding hot and gave off an acrid burning plastic odor. Definite safety hazard. Do not buy.

name: RapidCharge 65W GaN Wall Charger
reviews_title: Works fine but short cable included
reviews_text: The adapter itself charges quickly, but the bundled USB-C cable is barely 2 feet long, making it useless for hotel desks or wall sockets located near the baseboard.

name: Lundberg Organic Cinnamon Toast Rice Cakes
reviews_text: Light, crunchy, and just the right hint of cinnamon sweetness without artificial aftertaste. Perfect afternoon snack with almond butter.

name: Lundberg Organic Cinnamon Toast Rice Cakes
reviews_text: Both packages arrived completely crushed into powder because they were shipped in a flimsy bubble mailer instead of a sturdy cardboard box. Unusable as whole rice cakes.

name: Lundberg Organic Cinnamon Toast Rice Cakes
reviews_text: Always keep these stocked in my pantry. Great natural ingredients and satisfying crunch.

name: K-Y Love Sensuality Pleasure Gel
reviews_text: My partner and I experienced severe burning and skin irritation immediately after application. Would not recommend this product to anyone with sensitive skin.

name: K-Y Love Sensuality Pleasure Gel
reviews_text: Works well, doesn't dry out too quickly, and washes off cleanly without lingering residue.

name: UltraClean Robotic Vacuum Cleaner
reviews_title: Constantly gets stuck on low rugs
reviews_text: Mapping algorithm is frustrating. It gets stuck on the fringe of our dining rug every single day and sends error alerts. Requires constant supervision.

name: UltraClean Robotic Vacuum Cleaner
reviews_title: Saves me hours of cleaning every week
reviews_text: Handles dog hair effortlessly on hardwood and tile floors. Scheduling via the smartphone app is seamless and intuitive.

name: UltraClean Robotic Vacuum Cleaner
reviews_title: Died after 3 months and warranty unhelpful
reviews_text: Motor stopped spinning after three months. Support told me the battery and motor are only covered for 90 days and wanted $120 for repair. Terrible warranty support.
